[[File:Silver sickle detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''silver sickle''' can be made at 18 [[Crafting]] with a [[silver bar]] and a [[sickle mould]] at a [[furnace]], granting 50 Crafting [[experience]]. It can be turned into a [[Silver sickle (b)]] during [[Nature Spirit]] [[quest]], and can also be blessed after the quest by dipping it in the pool of water in the [[Filliman Tarlock|nature spirit's]] [[Nature Grotto|grotto]]. A blessed sickle can be used to cast [[Bloom]]; when cast, this spell drains your [[prayer]] slightly, and if you are in the [[Mort Myre Swamp]], it may grow fungi, saplings and golden pears on rotting logs, branches, and small bushes respectively, which can be used to fill a [[druid pouch]].
